name: Token Turrets
tagline: A real-time multiplayer tank battle where players stake a stablecoin in escrow and the ledger pays the winner.
problem: Online competitions with prizes depend on a trusted organizer.
solution: Players stake RLUSD to enter a room, the pot is held in ledger escrow, and the winner is paid automatically when the match ends; deployed live.
demo_moment: Team-described: join a room, fight, and see the payout arrive.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Ripple: Best in Ledger Award” among 261 submissions.
Stake, battle, payout with no middleman.

lessons: Put the sponsor's primitives (escrow, tokens) inside the game loop.
